title: Solidity Smart Contract Development
subtitle: Build and deploy production-ready smart contracts on EVM chains
description: Master Solidity from scratch and ship secure, gas-optimized smart contracts. Covers ERC-20, ERC-721, upgradeable proxies, and DeFi primitives.
longDesc: This course takes you from writing your first Solidity function to deploying a full DeFi protocol. You will learn how the EVM works under the hood, how to use Hardhat and Foundry, how to write gas-efficient code, and how to audit your own contracts before going live.

title: Full-Stack Web3 with Next.js
subtitle: Connect React frontends to smart contracts — ship a dApp in a weekend
description: Learn to build full-stack Web3 applications with Next.js 16, wagmi, viem, and IPFS. Go from a blank repo to a deployed dApp with a real contract backend.
longDesc: This course covers the complete stack for modern dApp development: Next.js App Router, Tailwind, wagmi/viem for contract calls, wallet connection with RainbowKit, on-chain data fetching, and IPFS for decentralized storage. By the end you will have shipped a functional NFT marketplace.

title: DeFi Protocol Engineering
subtitle: Architect and build your own lending, staking, and yield protocols
description: An advanced deep dive into DeFi protocol design. Study Aave, Uniswap, and Compound architectures, then build your own protocol from the ground up.
longDesc: For engineers who already know Solidity and want to build production DeFi. Covers automated market makers, interest rate models, liquidation mechanics, governance systems, and protocol security. Includes a complete clone of a major DeFi protocol as the capstone project.

title: Rust for Blockchain Development
subtitle: Write high-performance on-chain programs with Rust and Solana
description: Learn Rust from the ground up with a blockchain focus. Build Solana programs using the Anchor framework, write SPL tokens, and deploy to devnet.
longDesc: Rust is the language of high-performance blockchains. This course teaches Rust through the lens of blockchain development: ownership and lifetimes in the context of on-chain memory, serialization for account data, and the Anchor framework for Solana. No prior Rust knowledge needed.

title: Smart Contract Security Auditing
subtitle: Find and fix vulnerabilities like a professional auditor
description: A practitioner's guide to smart contract security. Learn to identify the top 20 vulnerability classes, use automated tools, and write professional audit reports.
longDesc: Security auditing is one of the highest-paid skills in Web3. This course walks through real vulnerabilities from past exploits, teaches you to think like an attacker, and gives you a repeatable auditing process used by professional firms. Includes 10 CTF challenges to sharpen your skills.

title: Zero-Knowledge Proofs in Practice
subtitle: Build zk-SNARKs and zk-STARKs for real applications
description: Demystify zero-knowledge proofs and build real circuits with Circom and Noir. Covers the math, the tooling, and practical use cases like private voting and identity.
longDesc: ZK proofs are the most exciting primitive in cryptography today. This course starts from the math — polynomial commitments, elliptic curves, and proof systems — then quickly gets practical with Circom circuits, Groth16 proofs, and on-chain verifiers. No cryptography background required.

title: Web3 Wallets & Ethers.js Fast Track
subtitle: Connect wallets, sign transactions, and read contract state in 3 hours
description: A fast-paced, hands-on workshop teaching modern wallet integration with Ethers.js, RainbowKit, and MetaMask. Ship transaction signing with zero fluff.
longDesc: Master the essential bridge between user wallets and blockchain networks. In this focused micro-course, you will learn how to connect MetaMask, Rabby, and WalletConnect, manage network switching, sign typed data (EIP-712), and handle wallet disconnects gracefully. Perfect for developers wanting quick, practical Web3 frontend skills at an accessible price.

lessons: Handling account and chain change events

title: Solidity Gas Optimization Masterclass
subtitle: Cut EVM transaction costs by up to 40% with assembly and opcode tricks
description: Concrete techniques to slash gas consumption in EVM smart contracts. Covers storage packing, custom errors, Yul assembly, and calldata caching.
longDesc: High gas costs kill dApp adoption. This intensive course teaches you the exact gas-saving techniques used by leading DeFi protocols. You will dive into EVM storage slot packing, immutable vs constant variables, unchecked math, calldata vs memory optimization, and targeted inline Yul assembly to reduce execution gas by up to 40%.
includes: Gas benchmark test suite in Foundry
Top 30 gas optimization patterns cheat sheet

title: DeFi Yield & Staking Fundamentals
subtitle: Understand liquidity pools, impermanent loss, and token staking math
description: Clear, actionable guide to how DeFi yields actually work. Learn liquidity provisioning, staking contract mechanics, and risk management.
longDesc: Demystify the mechanics behind DeFi yields. This course breaks down Automated Market Maker (AMM) liquidity pools, calculating real yields vs inflationary rewards, modeling impermanent loss, and interacting with single-sided staking and vault contracts. Includes code walkthroughs of Uniswap V2 and ERC-4626 Tokenized Vaults.

lessons: Smart contract risk vs economic risk
Evaluating token emissions and APY sustainability
